---
title: Spaghetti with Clams
id: MAR-0111
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg of clams
- 280 g of spaghetti
- 2 garlic cloves
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 2 tablespoons of fresh parsley
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Let the clams purge covered with a thin layer of salted water for about 2 hours; rinse and drain them.
2. Crush the garlic cloves and let them soften in a pan with the oil.
3. After 4 minutes, raise the heat, add the clams and let them open, shaking the pan often.
4. After about 5 minutes, turn off the heat, shell almost all the clams, except the largest ones, and strain the liquid; pour it into the clean pan and let it reduce slightly.
5. Cook the spaghetti in unsalted water, drain them very al dente, add them to the pan and finish cooking them so they absorb the clam liquid.
6. Add the shelled clams and the parsley, mix and serve on plates, finishing with the clams in their shells.
